title: SharePoint Intake Demonstration
subtitle: TEST ONLY - three live form submissions, local ACORN report

sections.mission: Demonstrate a traceable path from the Sponsor Highlights form through SharePoint JSONL collection to an ACORN report.
sections.challenge: Collect multiple submissions without a premium GitLab connector in the form.
approach: Submit three explicitly synthetic highlights through the published SharePoint pilot.
Preserve exported JSONL bytes and review the selected records before local ingestion.
impact: Show completed, in-progress and upcoming highlights in one local report.
